rationale: Version 9 (registered 2026-11-17 on the operator's four decisions of that day; docs/records/evals/2026-11-17-release-requirements-v9.md) changes five things and keeps every other v8 value. (1) Each evaluation role lists its collections, and a report scores every collection of its role together: development is heldout-dev-v0.8.18@adeeef40d7d81a7c with heldout-dev-v0.8.19-probes-r2@dd560a53b897dbca, confirmation is heldout-confirm-v0.8.18@681959088a46e5c6 with heldout-confirm-v0.8.19-probes-r2@8d423f96f9d5a1d4, and identities.dataset lists both confirmation collections with their rows sha256 (the proposal of docs/records/evals/2026-11-17-capability-probe-extension.md section 5). (2) The county decision: a county written in the town position is subregion. The v0.8.18 collections were revised (heldout/dataset/relabel.run.ts, revision county-in-locality-slot-subregion) into new manifests whose revision field lists every changed row: 23 development rows (21 usgov-nad Carter County and Johnston County, Oklahoma, and 2 gleif-lei co Dublin), 22 confirmation rows (all usgov-nad), and 1 development probe row (invented-po-box-cedex SCOTT COUNTY, IA). (3) postal_unit leaves out rows whose expected spans hold a venue (withoutTags), the 44 named-complex FR rows of each probe set that carry venue and no unit; no check's task reads a named complex beside a street line, and venue_unit's reads a venue with its unit designator. (4) The geocode requirement bounds the loss in the equal-country geocode outcome over the nine objective countries at 0.01, the check that can judge a change acting only in the resolver, which leaves every exact-parse outcome equal. (5) The Bonferroni family grows from 15 checks to 16 with the geocode check. Confirmation reads before registration: 10.8.0 scored heldout-confirm-v0.8.19-probes once as its baseline (r1, 2026-11-17) and heldout-confirm-v0.8.19-probes-r2 once (2026-11-17), each recorded in the capability-probe record; under v8 the candidate v8.7.0 seed 42 read heldout-confirm-v0.8.18 (version 8606834b12100089) with its postal card on 2026-11-16 (fail, v8.7.0 grading record section 3.1), with the shaped card the same day, again with the fixed postcode repair (insufficient evidence, section 9.3), and seed 43 was graded by lane AD on 2026-11-17. Under section 6.5 of HOLDOUT_AND_EVALUATION the failed candidate read retires the v0.8.18 confirmation rows for recipe selection; the v3 confirmation collection holds the same rows and inherits that status. Every threshold, statistic, provenance rule and identity other than identities.dataset is version 8's.

requirements.reason: Issue #2764: cited operator rules for FR (SP 8855 lines 2 and 3), GB (PAF Sub Building Name), IT (scala, piano, interno on line 3), AU (FLAT/UNIT TYPE table) and NZ (ADV358 Unit Type), with only designators no training recipe draws. The minimum mirrors the 0.85 of the other capabilities in the v3 decision record. Version 9 leaves out a row whose expected spans hold a venue: the FR named complexes (RESIDENCE, LOTISSEMENT), labeled venue since recipe fix 48fca721dd, carry no unit span, so they don't test this task.

requirements.task: Resolving an ordinary address to the components and admin places its answer key gives, on the geocode path production runs
requirements.reason: A change that acts only in the resolver, such as countyDesignatorFallback, leaves every exact-parse outcome equal, so no other check can judge it (lane Y, docs/records/evals/2026-11-17-county-fallback-and-arabic-fold.md). The outcome is heldout/per/geocode-outcome's: the resolved components and every written locality, dependent locality, subregion, region and country placed at its tag.
requirements.maxLossReason: The objective admits no exact-parse loss in the equal-country rate (minimumImprovement 0). The geocode outcome is bounded at one point of the same equal-country rate, a loss the development role resolves: at parity its 16-check bound on the nine countries' groups is under a quarter of a point wide.

inference.description: HELDOUT_INFERENCE_RULE in heldout/per/country.ts (served-locale-package): each row is parsed by the shipped Latin locale package for its country (release.config.json locales), falling back to en-us, with the row's country as localeHint; a package whose loader reports an unfed required channel is refused. The verdict records the rule and the rows each package parsed.

statistics.groupingAssumption: A row's independent unit is its group within its country: base_source_id when derived, else source_id. Rows are not declared independent, so a check that reads an ungrouped row is insufficient evidence. Limitation: structure shared across groups (one source's conventions, one place's many addresses) is not modelled. The dataset quota counts groups, not rows, against 1,000 per country.
